entities.name: Malikussaleh University
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Malikussaleh University is an Indonesian public university in North Aceh Regency. Founded in 1969 as a religious academy, it branched into multiple subjects, integrated into the modern university in 1989. It was nationalized in 2001.
